purpose: Resolve the remaining attribution, reference-noise, stationarity, spectral-localisation, and geometry-mask questions without launching DSMC or training.

cavity_contract.input: locked MV15C-A1 B3 predictions and all ten source blocks
cavity_contract.target: leave-one-seed-out mean of the other three Raw-B10 fields
fixed_attribution_arms: development-condition surface prior plus the identical frozen DCIR map
cavity_contract.development_prior: per-pixel least-squares surface in log10(Kn), U/100, and their interaction, using MV9 validation labels only
cavity_contract.continuous_Wiener_gain: S/(S+N/3) from the target-free MV15B development spectra; DC fixed to one
cavity_contract.reference_noise_formula: sqrt(max((r^2-1/4)/(3/4),0)) under the explicitly stated equal-independent-variance approximation

cylinder_contract.source: existing MV11 Bird/DS2V cylinder additive moments and locked MV16A predictions
cylinder_contract.operator: evaluate frozen nonzero DCT modes at native DS2V fluid-cell centres, solve area-weighted least squares, apply frozen gains, and enforce the exact area-weighted DC
primary_endpoints: area-weighted near-wall normal kinetic heat flux q_n NRMSE
cylinder_contract.q_n_definition: q_x x/r + q_y y/r reconstructed from cell kinetic moments; this is not a direct wall-collision heat-flux tally
cylinder_contract.multiple_endpoint_reporting: Holm adjustment for the two endpoint sign-test p-values
cylinder_contract.small_n_reason: For four independent seeds, the minimum attainable one-sided exact sign-test p-value is 1/16=0.0625.

publication_guard: A positive result supports effect-size and mechanism discussion for a JCP manuscript. Cavity MV15C-A1 remains the fresh q_y evidence; cylinder MV16B is explicitly retrospective because the existing trajectories and the tU/D=30 shortfall were known. Report confidence intervals and limitations, not a p<0.05 confirmation claim.
